reviewed.body: ### Describe the bug ```tsx a. {derived2()}{" "} b. {latest(derived2)} ``` we expect > a. 555 b. 555 but we get > a. b.555 ```tsx a. {derived2()}{" "} b. {latest(derived2)} ``` wrapping this in an element restore the missing value ### Your Example Website or App https://s.olid.uk/id/0gHNkArzT9mExG2BmwKUAQ ### Steps to Reproduce the Bug or Issue open playground and observe the missing value in the broken section ### Expected behavior consistent output in the 2 cases ### Screenshots or Videos ### Platform - OS: [e.g. macOS, Windows, Linux] - Browser: [e.g. Chrome, Safari, Firefox] - Version: [e.g. 91.1] ### Additional context _No response_
